six-views.title: The world of seed 1 after its last game, six ways
six-views.caption: The world with seed 1 after the game of iteration 1,499, the 2,495 of its 14,870 agents within 25 steps of agent 660,973, the oldest, 806 iterations old — a piece, since a world this large is a tangle when drawn whole: every agent drawn is a dot, every connection between two of them a faint line, and the dots sit in the same places in all six pictures (a ForceAtlas2 layout, seed 1, which pulls joined agents together). Each picture colours the dots by one of the quantities the viewer offers ([What the viewer can colour by](viewer-colours.md)): tokens and age on logarithmic scales; the change of tokens in the last game and the token curvature at its start on a signed scale, blue below zero, red above, dark at zero (both stretched logarithmically, the curvature cut at its 1st and 99th percentile); the family — which of the genotypes alive 100 iterations earlier each agent's genotype descends from, the seven largest in colour; and how many loops of a breadth-first cycle basis pass through each agent.
six-views.recipe:
**Runs.** `B1-100000-s001`.

**Data.** From each run's frames, `GraphOfLifeRuns/<run>/frames/`, read with `gol_store.read_frame(run, index)`; frame `2·t` is iteration *t* after reproduction and frame `2·t + 1` after the game.

1. Read frames `2998` (start of the last game) and `2999` (after it): `ids`, `tokens`, `ages`, `delta`, `brain_ids`, `edges`.
2. Curvature: in frame 2998, Σ over neighbours of (their tokens − own tokens).
3. Families: read frames 2799 to 2999, note each genotype's parent, and climb from each living genotype to one alive after the game of iteration 1,399.
4. Loops: as in [The geometry of a world](the-geometry-of-a-world.md).
5. Which agents are drawn: as in [What shape does the network take?](what-shape-does-the-network-take.md) (`book_chapters.society.shown`).
6. Lay out with `networkx.forceatlas2_layout(G, max_iter=200, seed=1)` and colour.

**To make it again:** `python3 book_figures.py colours`.

flows.title: Where the tokens went in the last game
flows.caption: The same world and layout; every connection is coloured by how many tokens crossed it in the last game, in both directions together, and drawn the wider the more crossed. Every connection that is left carried at least one token — the others were cut at the end of the game. Agents are small dots.
flows.recipe:
**Runs.** `B1-100000-s001`.

**Data.** From each run's frames, `GraphOfLifeRuns/<run>/frames/`, read with `gol_store.read_frame(run, index)`; frame `2·t` is iteration *t* after reproduction and frame `2·t + 1` after the game.

1. In frame `2999`, read `decisions.allocations`: for every agent and target ≠ itself, add the `alloc` to the connection between them.
2. Colour each connection of `edges` by its class.

**To make it again:** `python3 book_figures.py colours`.
